owner_report.shizuku_startup_path: PRoot ADB over Android Wireless Debugging

verified_protocol_distinction.adb_server_to_android_adbd: separate device-side endpoint; Wireless Debugging pairing and connect endpoint are distinct from 5037
verified_protocol_distinction.implication: Adding a PRoot ADB server does not by itself preserve or enable Wireless Debugging after reboot and does not replace the Shizuku service.

owner_adt_audit.topology: PRoot ADB relay on loopback TCP 5037 -> Android-side TCP 5555 bridge via shizuku_server
owner_adt_audit.custom_shizuku_boot_and_watchdog: reported to bootstrap/recover the device-side bridge after boot/crash
owner_adt_audit.dependency_conclusion: The local ADB relay on 5037 does not remove this workflow's cold-boot Shizuku bridge dependency; the 5555 property may persist during a session after Shizuku stops, but the audit reports the bridge/transport is unavailable after a full reboot without Shizuku.
owner_adt_audit.scope_limit: Dated ADT device topology; not independently revalidated as current Ternuxx runtime.

answer_to_dependency_question: A PRoot local server on 5037 organizes ADB clients only; it does not replace Shizuku's device-side bridge/boot path in the audited setup. Standard paired Wireless Debugging is a distinct ADB transport, but Shizuku-backed APIs still require Shizuku.
implementation_constraints: Keep PRoot ADB lifecycle separate from Ternuxx management TCP and Shizuku lifecycle.
Do not add a native Termux ADB package dependency without a separately approved requirement.
Before managing ADB, inspect the exact PRoot client/server versions, listener bind/owner, device authorization, and custom Shizuku fork/watchdog behavior read-only.
Do not enable a wildcard or off-device ADB listener by default.

sources.supports: Upstream ADB-mode Shizuku startup needs to be repeated after reboot because of system limitations.

limitations: Custom Shizuku fork identity, watchdog source, boot receiver, retry policy, Wireless Debugging enablement, and current endpoint are not verified.
